newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to remain weak throughout Monday with large-capitalised shares consolidating, brokers said.

They said the news, that Hyundai Group HYGR.CN was considering raising.e two trillion won by selling its assets and another one trillion won by offering rights issues in its affiliates, would pressre investor sentiment.
"Large-cap shares need fresh momentum for the next rally," said Jo Jae-hoon at Daewoo Securities. "Without follow-up signs of an economic turnaround, those shares will remain weak."
The index closed on Saturday at 767.27, down 1.03 points.

Brokers said the news Hyundai planned to improve its financial structure would be favourable from a longer point of view. But it could spark concerns about financial problems among smaller business conglomerates.
They said investors were likely to shy away from financial shares for the time being on worries about possible losses following recent devaluation of Asian currencies.
